column1: # Curated gloss alias map: surface gloss -> canonical gloss.
# Folds non-canonical surface glosses onto their canonical 207-item equivalent so
# the corpus aligns into a clean (concept x language) matrix. Applied by
# verbatim, so this is lossless and reversible.
# Keys/values are matched after norm_gloss() (NFC, lowercased, ws-collapsed).
# Every `canonical` target below is a real member of the eng_swadesh-2 207 list.
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored. Columns: alias<TAB>canonical<TAB>note
# DELIBERATELY NOT MAPPED (ambiguous -> needs human/etymological review; see TODO.md):
#   you (549)  -> singular or plural? ; fly (2) -> n. or v.? ; grease (2) -> fat (n.)?
#   woods (3)  -> forest or wood? ; breat (1) -> breast or breathe? ; tsy (1) -> unknown
#   male/female (1 each), heat (1) -> low impact, unclear part of speech
# NOT mapped because they are GENUINE extra concepts (a superset of the 207), e.g.
#   house, brother, sister, finger, shoulder, chin, navel, elbow, claw, fly (n.),
#   emu/kangaroo/crocodile/..., tomorrow/yesterday, we (incl.)/we two/you two, etc.
